compilation.meaning: Fresh host compilation; does not rerun fitting or the probe

exact_probe_sizeof_breakdown.accounting: Host ABI sizeof sums; linker padding, stack, stdio/libm runtime and external OCV storage are additional. Host replay/diagnostics are separate from bounded ingestion.

object_totals.incoming_sample_basis: scm_sample is three doubles; host double size inferred from 153-double factor payload
object_totals.model_state_and_model_row: Already embedded in bank/update workspace; not added again
object_totals.transactional_copy: Evidence workspace contains a staged evidence bank; remainder workspace contains a staged remainder bank. Both are counted. Paired update stages remainder, calls atomic evidence push, then commits remainder; no third bank copy is credited or hidden.
object_totals.query_snapshot: The remainder query directly uses the matched evidence history/event factors and allocates no new snapshot. The implemented probe nevertheless retains its original snapshot for diagnostics, so that object remains fully counted.
object_totals.paired_ancestry_binding: Remainder state includes an evidence-object pointer and sticky paired-ancestry flag; both are counted by sizeof. Shallow-copy/rebinding continuation is unsupported.
object_totals.workspace_aliasing_or_union: Not implemented. No hypothetical phase reuse subtracted from actual totals

partial_live_bounds.qualification: Partial accounting with known project frames; external frames and runtime allocation remain additional, so these are not complete runtime peak measurements

stack_interpretation: Compiler .su frames are tied to the recorded host compiler and flags.
Listed paths conservatively add emitted frames even where calls may be inlined; inlined-only functions have no additional frame beyond caller accounting.
Dynamic,bounded qualifiers are retained. No function reported dynamic,unbounded is silently accepted as bounded.
Call paths are source-derived estimates, not measured stack high-water marks or an exhaustive external-library call graph.
Local helpers are keyed by source file and function to avoid combining unrelated same-named functions. Maximum emitted constprop/isra frame per source/function is used conservatively.
Paired-update remainder advancement and evidence advancement execute sequentially; their descendant frames are separate paths, not incorrectly summed as simultaneous callees.

external_or_unmeasured_costs: Compiler/ABI-dependent caller frames, interrupt context, task stack and scheduling overhead.
libm calls (hypot, exp, expm1, tanh, log and others) and libc/stdio frames and buffers.
FILE objects, dynamic loader, allocator bookkeeping and host runtime allocations.
Acquisition buffering, communications, persistent-checkpoint buffers and other application state.

External curve storage is zero in this run. B002 supports only the smooth illustrative OCV and explicitly rejects measured PWL tables; future curve/table storage and validated derivative enclosures are additional work.
Target instruction/text size, soft-float implementation, MCU stack, latency, flash and energy.
